text:
Ana: Quick sync — launching the Mini Tutorial sequence next week. Need final copy for the refapp post, a short benchmark narrative, and a lightweight webinar to drive inbound. Who can take the lead on the landing page + tracking?

Mike: I can own the landing page. Will set up UTMs + form. Planning to push a simple 3-step funnel: tutorial -> live demo -> benchmark download.

Ravi: I’ll draft the benchmark narrative. Short, punchy: 3 charts (latency vs tokens, cost/unit, quality tradeoffs). Can we get sample workloads by EOD?

Jasper: I have a small refapp dataset from last sprint that matches the tutorial flow. Linking: https://redwood.ai/refapp-mini (draft) — use that for the bench.

Ana: Awesome. Mike — can you wire the form to HubSpot and tag leads as "mini-tutorial-webinar"? We want routing rules to the community SDR queue. commops-bot, can you confirm HubSpot webhook name?

commops-bot: HubSpot webhook: hs_webhook_minitut. New form should use property: source_campaign = "mini_tutorial_seq". Confirmed.

Mike: HubSpot done. I’ll add a hidden field utm_campaign=mini_tutorial_seq and route to funnel: community-sdr@redwood.ai. Also adding an autoresponder with webinar reg link + calendar invite.

Ravi: Draft bench narrative in comments — keeping it under 300 words. Will include callouts: "typical latency improvements with batching" and a note on quantization tradeoffs. Posting in docs repo by 5pm.

Ana: Nice. For the webinar — make it 30 mins: 15 demo, 10 bench story, 5 Q&A. Target audience: developers who evaluate infra economics. Promo channels: community newsletter, twitter, dev Slack, OSS channels.

Jasper: Can we produce a short code sample for the tutorial that includes the exact SDK call for streaming + caching? I'll paste snippet into the refapp README.

Mike: Good idea. Also planning a short paid push (small budget) to dev audiences — target signup audience.

Ana: Messaging check: Pilar suggested lead copy to focus on "real-world cost/latency wins" instead of raw model numbers. Keep tweets and subject lines benefit-focused.

Ravi: Draft subject lines: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency" / "Mini tutorial: deploy a refapp with 2x cost savings" — which one?

Ana: Go with the first for the newsletter, second for paid ads. Keep the benchmark claim conservative: "up to 2x cost improvement in our tests" and link to full notes.

Mike: Timeline: landing + form ready by Wed, bench draft Wed EOD, webinar Tues next week, promo starts Thurs. Sounds tight but doable.

Jasper: I'll prep the refapp README + code snippet today. Also record a 5-min demo video we can embed.

Ana: Perfect. Last ask — commops-bot, please create a short tracking tag in the marketing dashboard and set conversion goal to "webinar_reg_complete".

commops-bot: Tracking tag created: mini_tutorial_seq_v1. Conversion goal set. :white_check_mark:
